E006.description: Mao has been a great leader for our nation,
E006.description1: We must disband it before it gets out of hand.
E006.description2: We shall let it continue but it shall have no power in politics.
E006.description3: Mao is the greatest leader we could ever have, Such a man deserves a Cult of Personality.
E006.title: Question of the Personality Cult

E008.description: We must crush the unloyal, Mao must have full power over the nation and its people, We will mold this nation in his image.
E008.description1: Forwards for Mao and our people.
E008.title: Onwards for the people.

E005.description: Our great revolution needs a figurehead. It will boost morale for our troops and it will decide what our great nation will be.
E005.description1: Mao will be a great figurehead for our people and nation going forward.
E005.description2: Chiang Kai-shek will be a great military leader for this uprising and in the future.
E005.description3: Puyi will lead china back on its path of monarchism.
E005.title: The question of leadership

E003.description: The oppresion of the people has gone on for too long, Manchuria will be free of the Japanese controll, Manchuria will rise from the ashes.
E003.description1: An end too the fascist pigs is here.
E003.title: The people have had enough.

E007.description: As the cult of personality is rising up all eyes are on one man, Mao who will he support?
E007.description1: It is time for us to rise up, We will take over this great nation in the name of Mao.
E007.description2: For the republic and the people we shall crush them.
E007.title: The next step.
E007.answer1: We will be greater in his image.

E002.description: As the only true Christian nation in the far east we must unite Russia in the lords name and light. We all know we shall reunite the lands, Afterall the Lord favors us.
E002.description1: Father Alexander will lead our people to greatness.
E002.title: A nation of Christ.

E004.description: We shall stomp out the fascist pigs and Japanese collaborators China and Manchuria will be free once more.
E004.description1: The people will rise from the ashes.
E004.title: The people stand.

E001.description: On the first month of 1963 a new nation has been proclaimed in the far east, The Divine Mandate sees to restore Russia in Gods eyes.
E001.description1: We shall see how they guide the people.
E001.title: The Divine Mandate
